meta.title: Dream Unity
meta.subtitle: A living map from ether to embodiment and back again

nodes.title: Dream Unity
nodes.essence: Dream worlds are compressed, synthesised and realised in the physical before returning, transformed, to their originating ether.
nodes.bodyMarkdown: The central living model. Dream Unity is not merely a collection of imagined worlds; it is a cycle through which potential becomes form, forms discover relation, relation becomes strategy, and strategy becomes embodied reality. Return preserves what was learned while reopening possibility.

nodes.title: Ether
nodes.essence: The field of uncommitted potential from which forms arise and to which completed forms can return.

nodes.title: Compression
nodes.essence: Distillation that preserves generative structure while removing noise and repetition.

nodes.title: Synthesis
nodes.essence: A reversible unity that creates something new without erasing the irreducible difference of its sources.

nodes.title: Realisation
nodes.essence: The passage from inward possibility to embodied act, artifact, practice or observable consequence.

nodes.title: Return to Ether
nodes.essence: Reversible release: a form is archived, unfolded or reopened without destroying its lineage.

nodes.title: Dream Maker
nodes.essence: The domain in which imagination, identity and agency deliberately form inner possibility.

nodes.title: Dream Machine
nodes.essence: The domain in which relations, constraints and generative processes transform forms into coherent models.

nodes.title: Dream World
nodes.essence: The domain in which models become navigable environments, artifacts and lived consequences.

nodes.title: Consciousness Forms
nodes.essence: Sensory, affective, imaginal and belief-structured forms that shape what can be experienced.

nodes.title: Relational Forms
nodes.essence: Patterns, analogies, distinctions and transformations through which separate forms become intelligible together.

nodes.title: Strategic Forms
nodes.essence: Models of action that coordinate choice, prediction, commitment and execution through time.

nodes.title: Primality
nodes.essence: The living capacity to originate impulse, test limits and extend one’s nature without surrendering authorship.

nodes.title: Sovereignty
nodes.essence: Integrated authority over one’s awareness, choices and creative direction.

nodes.title: Agency
nodes.essence: The capacity to choose and act from an authored centre rather than merely react to the system.

nodes.title: Imagination
nodes.essence: The faculty that generates forms not yet constrained to present physical conditions.

nodes.title: The Ghost in the Mirror
nodes.essence: A reflected representation that ceases to serve the living self and begins governing it.
nodes.bodyMarkdown: A diagnostic model of inversion: the material image, social proxy or self-concept becomes more vital than the living primal source it once reflected. The question “Who am I?” can then be generated by the reflected system rather than by recovered agency.

mirror.directExperience: Living impulse, embodied vitality and authored desire.
mirror.representation: The self-image, social role or material proxy that originally reflected the living source.
mirror.primalValue: Sovereignty over one’s own creative direction.
mirror.inversionRisk: The reflection becomes the governor of the source.
mirror.falsifier: A proxy that consistently expands rather than narrows authored agency would resist the inversion claim.
mirror.restoringAction: Reconnect representation to a chosen embodied act and test whether agency increases.

nodes.title: Material Inversion
nodes.essence: The proxy, image or possession becomes more vital than the living capacity it was meant to extend.

nodes.title: Domestication of Vitality
nodes.essence: Repeated external governance progressively narrows spontaneous agency into predictable compliance.

nodes.title: Inner Light
nodes.essence: A lived centre of value and orientation that does not require the outer world to authorise its existence.

nodes.title: Creative Freedom
nodes.essence: The practical ability to transform imagination into chosen form while retaining responsibility for consequences.

nodes.title: Wisdom
nodes.essence: The capacity to exercise freedom without becoming enslaved by the instruments, pleasures or images freedom makes available.

nodes.title: Embodied Awareness
nodes.essence: Physical limitation is a testing ground through which awareness becomes demonstrable agency.

nodes.title: Become
nodes.essence: A practice for deliberately switching sensory form, vibe, reality frame and belief before applying the shift to life.

nodes.title: Relational Training
nodes.essence: Practice across analogy, topology, constraints, trajectories and rule systems to make relation itself more flexible.

nodes.title: Observe → Integrate → Predict → Commit → Execute
nodes.essence: A strategic cycle that carries perception through a model and into decisive embodied action.

nodes.title: Unity Forge
nodes.essence: A synthesis practice that records shared invariants, irreducible differences, tensions, emergence and omissions.

nodes.title: Mirror Test
nodes.essence: A diagnostic that separates lived essence from representation and names the proxy, inversion risk and restoring action.

nodes.title: Reality Bridge
nodes.essence: A method that connects a claim to a practice, prediction, observable outcome and reflective update.

nodes.title: What survives unification?
nodes.essence: Which invariants must remain when dream forms are compressed, and which losses would falsify the synthesis?

nodes.title: Freedom and Constraint
nodes.essence: Agency requires constraint to become testable, yet constraint can also harden into domestication.

nodes.title: The Ghost in the Mirror — Of Slavery and Freedom

views.title: Mirror & Freedom

views.description: A diagnostic view of reflection, inversion, vitality and recovered authorship.
